purpose: Define the minimum ready/done contract for PR-sized product, app, CI, deploy, and operating-system changes.
delivery_model: branch -> pull request -> checks -> review -> merge

protected_surfaces: auth routing and AuthContext session hydration
calendar event creation and Google Calendar sync boundary
CI, deploy, rollback, verification policy, and repo-local AI guidance
approval_required_for: package-manager migration or non-canonical lockfile rewrites
live deploys, service restarts, secret rotation, or credentialed smoke against production
behavior changes to protected app surfaces outside the stated work item

work_item_required_fields.definition: The customer, operator, or engineering problem being solved.
The observable condition that proves the work item succeeded.
The user-visible workflow or operational path protected by the change.
Files, services, workflows, data contracts, or docs in scope.
Required and advisory checks from .jarvis/verification_contract.json, plus any focused smoke.
How the change is promoted, what aborts promotion, and how it is reverted or rolled back.

definition_of_ready.name: problem framed
definition_of_ready.evidence: Target user or operator, current pain, and why now are written in the issue, PR, or docs/product/prfaq-template.md.

definition_of_ready.name: critical journey named
definition_of_ready.evidence: The primary journey or operational flow is linked to docs/product/critical-user-journeys.md or explicitly marked not applicable.

definition_of_ready.name: scope bounded
definition_of_ready.evidence: Owned files and protected surfaces are listed, with non-goals called out for adjacent behavior.

definition_of_ready.name: acceptance criteria testable
definition_of_ready.evidence: At least one observable acceptance check is written in user, operator, or CI terms.

definition_of_ready.name: verification selected
definition_of_ready.evidence: Required commands and any blocked smoke checks are selected from .jarvis/verification_contract.json before implementation.

definition_of_ready.name: rollback path known
definition_of_ready.evidence: PR revert, artifact rollback, or previous_release promotion path is named before changing release-sensitive surfaces.

definition_of_done.name: implemented within scope
definition_of_done.evidence: Diff only touches the approved work-item surfaces or documents an approved scope expansion.

definition_of_done.name: required gates executed
definition_of_done.evidence: Exact commands, pass/fail results, and blockers are recorded in the PR or release-readiness report.

definition_of_done.name: behavior preserved or intentionally changed
definition_of_done.evidence: Protected auth, Firebase, task, habit, calendar, profile, rank, and leaderboard behavior is unchanged unless explicitly accepted.

definition_of_done.name: release impact documented
definition_of_done.evidence: CI, deploy, rollback, or verification changes update docs/ops/release-readiness-report.md and related .jarvis contracts.

definition_of_done.name: rollback remains available
definition_of_done.evidence: Guidance/config changes can be PR-reverted; runtime changes identify previous_release and smoke checks.

definition_of_done.name: handoff complete
definition_of_done.evidence: Final report names changed files, verification evidence, deploy/smoke evidence, unresolved risks, and next safe step.

change_classes.rollback: revert the PR; do not deploy the candidate artifact

minimum_verification: focused regression test or documented manual smoke for the touched critical journey
change_classes.rollback: redeploy previous_release or revert the release PR, then check /health and rerun auth/task smoke where credentials permit
